g.text: Reversing a conditional probability: the flaw sensor

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: 10% of parts are flawed. The sensor flags 90% of flawed parts and 20% of good parts.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #222222

g.text: P(flag | flawed) = 0.90 but P(flawed | flag) = 90/270 = 1/3. Conditional probabilities are not symmetric.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: Bayes: P(D|F) = P(F|D)P(D) / P(F), with P(F) = 0.9(0.1) + 0.2(0.9) = 0.27. With only 1% flawed it drops to 0.043.
